Satono Crown had completely burned herself 
out in the race. Her sheer enthusiasm for 
a graded race and the resulting nerves 
seemed to have exhausted her far beyond 
what was necessary.

To become a famous Umamusume, she won't 
repeat her mistakes. Vowing this, the path 
she chose was the Classic Triple Crown 
route.

The Satsuki Sho, the Japan Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho. Winning the title of "Derby 
Umamusume" in particular is an honor every 
renowned racer strives for.

The next race is the Yayoi Sho, the prep 
race for the Satsuki Sho. To ensure 
thorough preparation, she decided to treat 
the rest of her Junior class period as an 
adjustment phase.
